# device42_auto_discovery_networks (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_networks" "example" {
  name           = "example"
  server         = "hostname.domain.local"
  schedule_days  = "0,2,4"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the networks autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).

### Optional

- `clear_customer` (String) Whether to clear the customer association. Defaults to `no`.
- `do_port_check` (String) Whether to perform a port check. Defaults to `no`.
- `end_ip` (String) End of the IP address range.
- `exclude_servers` (String) Comma separated list of addresses to exclude.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `server` (String) IP or FQDN of the target server.
- `snmp_min_parallel` (Int) Minimum number of parallel SNMP requests.
- `snmp_retries` (Int) Number of SNMP retries. Defaults to `1`.
- `snmp_timeout` (Int) SNMP timeout in seconds. Defaults to `5`.
- `snmp_v3` (String) Whether to use SNMP v3. Defaults to `no`.
- `start_ip` (String) Start of the IP address range.
- `tags` (String) Comma separated list of tags to attach.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
